hp-flour.reason: Vital wheat gluten is a 75 g/100 g protein isolate, not a blended high-protein flour. No high-protein flour record exists in the selected USDA releases.

hp-roti.reason: A high-protein roti is a formulated product; the commercial plain chapati record halves its protein and doubles its energy.

hp-tortilla.reason: A high-protein tortilla is a formulated product; the plain flour tortilla record reports 2.8 g protein against the label's 12 g.

lentil-pasta.reason: The app component is dry lentil pasta; the selected record was cooked protein-fortified wheat spaghetti, wrong in both ingredient and state. No dry legume pasta record exists in the selected releases.

jackfruit-sabzi.reason: Canned jackfruit in syrup is a sweetened fruit pack, not a cooked spiced sabzi.

salad-dressing.reason: Every creamy dressing candidate in the audit is a reduced-calorie or flavored variant; no regular creamy dressing record is available, and the reduced-calorie record understates energy by two thirds.

protein-pancakes.reason: The only pancake candidates are ordinary or gluten-free pancakes at 4.8 g protein against the label's 30 g. No protein-pancake record exists in the selected releases.

seitan.reason: Cooked seitan is hydrated gluten; vital wheat gluten is the dry flour and triples the energy per 100 g.

poke-bowl.reason: A frozen chicken rice-bowl entree is a different dish; no poke or raw-fish rice-bowl record exists in the selected releases.

katsu-curry.reason: Chicken curry with rice omits the breaded fried cutlet that defines katsu curry; no rebase of that record reaches a plausible katsu-curry energy value.

gyudon.reason: The "Beef and rice with soy-based sauce" record carries only 8 g carbohydrate per 100 g, which cannot represent a rice bowl; its macro shape is wrong regardless of the portion chosen.

onigiri.reason: Plain cooked short-grain rice omits the filling and nori that define onigiri.

tonkatsu.reason: Restaurant sweet-and-sour pork is a different dish with a different batter and sauce; no breaded pork cutlet record exists in the selected releases.

japchae.reason: The selected record is dehydrated cellophane noodles, not the cooked dressed dish; it reports 351 kcal and 0.2 g protein per 100 g.

kimbap.reason: A vegetable sushi roll at a 22 g piece understates kimbap, which is a larger filled roll; no kimbap record exists in the selected releases.

revertToCatalogNote: Components listed in revertToCatalog withdraw the CP3A USDA nutrition claim and restore the inherited pre-CP3A catalog macros under provenance record "inherited-catalog-nutrition" (licenseStatus "unapproved"). revertToCatalog takes precedence over selectionOverrides; a retained selectionOverrides entry for the same id preserves its authored dietClass/containsOnionGarlic metadata and records the selection a future re-run would make if the revert were lifted.
